answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy places every newcomer on a walnut probation tier and locks its bond for 25 epochs. Three randomly drawn auditors replay separate tasks; one failed replay burns 20 percent of the bond. A kernel sponsor quota permits only two new identities per epoch, while a ridge fingerprint index quarantines accounts whose signed outputs cluster too closely. Full rewards unlock after seven clean rounds, so clones burn capital and time; task hashes keep the audit trail reproducible.
